SETTINGS.TITLE: Settings
SETTINGS.LEAD: Configure company identity, branding, contact details, and public website content without changing code.

UNSAVED.TITLE: Unsaved changes
UNSAVED.TEXT: You have unsaved settings. Leave this page and discard them?

GENERAL.COMPANY_HELP: These names appear in the website header, footer, login screen, and browser title.

BRANDING.LOGOS_HELP: Images are compressed and stored in Firestore. Use a transparent logo when possible.
BRANDING.COLORS_HELP: These colors update the website theme after you save.
BRANDING.PRIMARY_HELP: Used for buttons and key links across the website.
BRANDING.TEXT_SAMPLE: Card text shows how body copy will look with these colors.

CONTACT.WHATSAPP_HELP: Enter the number with country code and no plus sign, for example 201000000000.
CONTACT.WHATSAPP_FORM: Allow WhatsApp as a lead contact option

SOCIAL.TITLE: Social accounts
SOCIAL.HELP: Enable only the platforms you use. Empty or disabled links stay hidden on the public website.
SOCIAL.EMPTY: No social links are enabled yet.

HOMEPAGE.FEATURED_HELP: Store only project and property IDs here. The catalog records stay in their own collections.

SEO.HELP: Used as the default browser title, description, and social preview unless a page has its own values.

LOCALIZATION.TITLE: Languages
LOCALIZATION.HELP: Interface translations stay in the language files. These settings only control which languages visitors can use.
LOCALIZATION.RTL_HELP: Arabic uses right-to-left automatically. English uses left-to-right.

SYSTEM.NAVIGATION_HELP: Hide pages that this company does not use.

PROJECTS.TITLE: Projects
PROJECTS.LEAD: Create and manage developments with bilingual content, media, and amenities.
PROJECTS.CREATE_LEAD: Enter Arabic and English content, then save the project before adding units.
PROJECTS.EDIT_LEAD: Update project information without losing existing unpublished fields.
PROJECTS.EMPTY_LEAD: Add the first project to start attaching properties.
PROJECTS.DELETE_TEXT: This will permanently remove {{name}}. Properties must be moved or deleted first.

PROPERTIES.TITLE: Properties
PROPERTIES.LEAD: Manage primary, resale, and rental units. Primary units belong to a project; resale and rental can be standalone.
PROPERTIES.CREATE_LEAD: Choose the listing type first. Primary units require a project; resale and rental can be saved without one.
PROPERTIES.EDIT_LEAD: Update this unit while keeping existing media unless you replace it.
PROPERTIES.EMPTY_LEAD: Add a property. Primary units attach to a project; resale and rental can stand alone.

FIELDS.PROJECT_HINT: Optional for resale and rental. Leave empty if this unit is not part of a project.

DEVELOPERS.TITLE: Developers
DEVELOPERS.LEAD: Manage developer names, logos, and website links used across projects.
DEVELOPERS.CREATE_LEAD: Enter the developer name in Arabic and English. The logo is stored as an optimized image in Firestore.
DEVELOPERS.EDIT_LEAD: Update this developer. Linked projects keep the same developer ID.
DEVELOPERS.EMPTY_LEAD: Add a developer before attaching projects.
DEVELOPERS.DELETE_TEXT: This will permanently remove {{name}}. Projects using this developer must be reassigned first.

AMENITIES.TITLE: Amenities
AMENITIES.LEAD: Configure reusable features that can be attached to projects and properties.
AMENITIES.CREATE_LEAD: Enter the amenity in Arabic and English, then choose an icon and category.
AMENITIES.EDIT_LEAD: Update this amenity. Existing project and property links keep the same ID.
AMENITIES.EMPTY_LEAD: Add amenities so projects and properties can select them.
AMENITIES.DELETE_TEXT: This will permanently remove {{name}}. It cannot be deleted while a project or property still uses it.

LOCATIONS.TITLE: Locations
LOCATIONS.LEAD: Manage cities, areas, and map links used by projects and properties.
LOCATIONS.CREATE_LEAD: Enter the location in Arabic and English, then add map coordinates if available.
LOCATIONS.EDIT_LEAD: Update this location. Linked projects and properties keep the same location ID.
LOCATIONS.EMPTY_LEAD: Add a location before attaching projects.
LOCATIONS.DELETE_TEXT: This will permanently remove {{name}}. Projects or properties using it must be reassigned first.

PROPERTY_TYPES.TITLE: Property types
PROPERTY_TYPES.LEAD: Configure the unit types that properties can be classified as.
PROPERTY_TYPES.CREATE_LEAD: Enter the type in Arabic and English, then choose an icon and category.
PROPERTY_TYPES.EDIT_LEAD: Update this type. Existing properties keep the same type ID.
PROPERTY_TYPES.EMPTY_LEAD: Add property types so units can be classified.
PROPERTY_TYPES.DELETE_TEXT: This will permanently remove {{name}}. It cannot be deleted while a property still uses it.

LEADS.TITLE: Leads
LEADS.LEAD: Review incoming inquiries, contact customers, and update their status.
LEADS.SEARCH: Search by name, phone, email, or property
LEADS.EMPTY_LEAD: Inquiries from the website will appear here.
LEADS.DELETE_TEXT: This will permanently remove the inquiry from {{name}}.
LEADS.NO_MESSAGE: No message was included with this inquiry.
LEADS.NOTES_HELP: Internal notes are only visible to admins. Buyer readiness from the website form is shown with the customer details and is kept when you save.
LEADS.WHATSAPP_MESSAGE: Hello {{name}}, following up on your inquiry about {{property}}.

USERS.TITLE: Users & permissions
USERS.LEAD: Invite team members, assign roles, and control exactly what every account can do.
USERS.SEARCH: Search by name, email, or phone
USERS.EMPTY_LEAD: Add a team member to give them dashboard access.
USERS.CREATE_LEAD: Create the sign-in account, choose a role, then fine-tune the permissions.
USERS.EDIT_LEAD: Update personal information, role, status, and permissions.
USERS.DETAILS_LEAD: Review this account, its role, and everything it is allowed to do.
USERS.PERMISSIONS_LEAD: Grant only the actions this user needs.
USERS.PERMISSIONS_HELP: Tick the actions this user may perform. You can never grant a permission you do not hold yourself.
USERS.PERMISSIONS_LOCKED: Only a super admin can change permissions.
USERS.NO_ACTIONS: You are not allowed to manage this account.
USERS.ROLE_LOCKED: You are not allowed to change this role.
USERS.STATUS_HINT: Inactive users keep their data but cannot sign in to the dashboard.
USERS.CREDENTIALS_HELP: Set a temporary password. The user can choose their own password from the email we send them.
USERS.DELETE_TEXT: {{name}} loses dashboard access immediately. The sign-in account itself must be removed from the Firebase console.
USERS.DEACTIVATE_TEXT: {{name}} will not be able to sign in until the account is activated again.
USERS.CONFIRM_ACCESS_TEXT: This changes what {{name}} can reach in the dashboard.
USERS.CONFIRM_PERMISSIONS_TEXT: {{name}} immediately gains or loses access to the selected actions.

FIELDS.NAME: Full name
FIELDS.EMAIL_LOCKED: The email is managed by Firebase Authentication and cannot be changed here.
FIELDS.SEND_PASSWORD_EMAIL: Email this user a link to set their own password

ROLE_HINTS.SUPER_ADMIN: Full access to every module, plus user and permission management.
ROLE_HINTS.ADMIN: Manages content, catalog, leads, and settings. Cannot change permissions.
ROLE_HINTS.STAFF: Limited access. Start from the defaults and add only what is needed.
